title: Divergence: doc-drift.py load_doc_files silently drops a [[route]] entry whose crate_pattern is MISSING — the design-field doc leaves the checked set and the gate can exit 0 (REQ-1/REQ-8/REQ-9)
description: Probe: a [[route]] entry with design = ".design/orphan.md" and NO crate_pattern key, alongside one valid route -> gate exits 0, .design/orphan.md never named. Authority: .design/tooling/doc-drift-tripwire.md REQ-5 ('every doc referenced by a [[route]].design field'), REQ-1 ('the set of checked docs is exactly the deduplicated design fields'), REQ-8 (no grandfathering: routed doc without audited-sha is MISSING-PIN, exit 1), REQ-9 ('The tool never exits 0 without having checked all 48 docs') + goal.md R-HONEST-3. The schema header in tooling/spec-routes.toml marks crate_pattern '# required', so the entry is also legally treatable as wrong-shaped (exit 3, the #260 class). Either reading forbids exit 0 with the doc invisible. Realistic trigger: a typo'd field name (crate_patern =) in one entry silently shrinks coverage while the gate stays green. The #260 validator ('if present must be a string') lets the None case fall through to the builder-era 'if not design or not pattern: continue'. Related degenerate the same fix should decide: design = "" (empty string) alongside valid routes is likewise silently dropped (no real doc loses coverage there, so not separately pinned). NOT divergent (audited, accepted): an entry with crate_pattern but NO design names no routed doc — REQ-1 checked set unaffected; file-side governance is spec-discipline's domain. Parent #258; follows fixer commits d5b95455 (#259) / 73776c32 (#260).

comments.content: Failing test at tooling/tests/test_doc_drift_critic.py::DocDriftCriticTest::test_c3_design_only_route_entry_must_not_vanish_into_exit_0 demonstrates divergence (run with DOC_DRIFT_DIVERGENCE=1; observed exit 0, CURRENT for the valid doc only, .design/orphan.md invisible). Skip-gated per the C-1/C-2 convention so the default suite stays green while this tracks.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content: Critic plan: pin the divergence with skip-gated test C-3 in tooling/tests/test_doc_drift_critic.py (appended; C-1/C-2 untouched), asserting the REQ-9-legal outcomes (exit 1 MISSING-PIN naming .design/orphan.md per REQ-8, or exit 3 wrong-shaped per the #260 class) and forbidding exit 0. Verified failing ungated (observed exit 0), suite green gated (13 run / 1 skipped). Commit the test as the audit artifact; fix is the generator's, not mine.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Fixer plan (#261): root cause is the builder-era `if not design or not pattern: continue` in load_doc_files (tooling/doc-drift.py L248-249) — a per-entry fail-open that silently drops a [[route]] entry missing a required field, shrinking the checked-doc set while the gate stays green. The #260 isinstance guards reject only present-but-wrong-type; None (missing key) and "" (empty string) fall through to the continue.

Authority: spec-routes.toml schema header marks BOTH crate_pattern and design "# required"; .design/tooling/doc-drift-tripwire.md REQ-1 (checked set = exactly the deduplicated design fields), REQ-5, REQ-8 (no grandfathering), REQ-9 (never exit 0 without checking all docs). An entry missing/empty in either required field is WRONG-SHAPED -> route it through the #260 EnvironmentError3 class -> exit 3, naming the entry index and the missing/empty field. This subsumes the critic's MISSING-PIN reading and the design-missing "acceptable" case: the schema says required, so reject uniformly. The continue dies.

Fix (single file tooling/doc-drift.py): in the per-entry loop, after the type guards, raise EnvironmentError3 when design or crate_pattern is missing or empty, naming entry #i and the field. Remove the now-unreachable continue. Composes after the #259 zero-routes guard and #260 isinstance guards.

Ungate test_c3; tighten its assertion to exactly exit 3 (the implemented-and-spec'd class) since the fix produces 3. Gauntlet: python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v (expect 13 run / 0 skipped / 0 failed); live tree exit 1; git diff scripts/audit.sh empty.

comments.author: Yffe
comments.content:
Fixed in commit 1523b7ed (single file tooling/doc-drift.py + its ungated regression test).

Root cause: the builder-era `if not design or not pattern: continue` in load_doc_files silently dropped a [[route]] entry missing/empty in a required field, shrinking the REQ-1 deduplicated-design checked set while the gate could exit 0 (a one-doc fail-open). The #260 type guards reject only present-but-wrong-type; None (missing key) and "" (empty) fell through.

Fix: after the type guards, raise EnvironmentError3 (exit 3, the #260 INCONCLUSIVE class) when design or crate_pattern is missing or empty, naming entry #i and the field; removed the now-unreachable continue. Authority: spec-routes.toml schema header (both fields "# required") + REQ-1/REQ-5/REQ-8/REQ-9 + R-HONEST-3. The REQ-8-or-REQ-9 alternative resolved to the wrong-shape exit-3 reading (schema says required -> reject uniformly), subsuming the MISSING-PIN reading and the design-missing "acceptable" case.

Test: ungated test_c3_design_only_route_entry_must_not_vanish_into_exit_0 and TIGHTENED its assertion from exit in (1,3) to exactly 3.

Gauntlet (integer counts):
- python3 -m unittest discover -s tooling/tests -v -> 13 run / 0 skipped / 0 failed
- python3 tooling/doc-drift.py -> exit 1, 48 MISSING-PIN + 1 DRIFT (live tree unchanged; the missing/empty-field path is not exercised by the real table — all 107 entries carry both required fields)
- git diff -- scripts/audit.sh -> empty (AC-7 byte-identical)

No new pub API. Handing back for acto-critic re-audit.
